About the author

After ten books, two Hollywood movies, and a #1 New York Times bestseller, I'm sometimes asked: "Why not write thrillers?" My answer goes something like this: the world is so dark, preposterous and

...

So for me the genre must be non-fiction. Of course, I borrow techniques from good novel writing, such as pace and a sense of place. But the quotes are true - said to me and others - as are my observations and conclusions. This method has led to books on Edward Snowden, the poisoned Moscow dissident Alexander Litvinenko, and Russia’s transformation into a KGB-run shadow state. I was in Kyiv in February 2022 when Putin launched his full-scale invasion of Ukraine—a fascist project of recolonisation, dressed up in the

...

Early reviewers have been kind - “more gripping than a thriller”, (Andrey Kurkov), “dark and compelling” (Bill Browder) and “war reporting at its finest” (Serhii Plokhy). It is, I hope, an essential guide to our uncertain age, and to the return of Great Power politics. I hope you enjoy reading it. Luke Harding September 2026
